limits: Finite controls only. The class-number quick control uses Magma defaults and is not an independent unconditional proof. Unconditional class-number-one support comes from Washington and the full Minkowski-bound producer records. An initial fixed-ideal control mistake was corrected by quantifying over the conjugates already permitted by DF3; the mathematical statements were unchanged.
output_completeness_guard: An extracted control once produced an empty stdout log despite exit0. Earlier records are preserved in the closure audit. The runner now requires case-specific result/completion markers; final working and extracted runs are repeated using that guard. No mathematical control algorithm or manuscript statement changed.
